title: Paint protection film
description: Film coverage for high-impact panels, the full front or the full body.
heading: Choose the coverage first.
intro: Paint protection film (PPF) is a transparent urethane layer applied over painted panels. The film is designed to absorb and spread the force of stone chips and everyday scuffs, so less reaches the paint. Films differ in quality and properties, so the studio confirms which film and which coverage suit your car before quoting.
choices: High-impact kit
Selected impact-prone areas. The studio confirms the exact panels on your car.
Full front
The whole front end. The studio confirms the exact panels on your car.
Full body
Every painted panel, not just the front.
question: Bring your car for a paint inspection before the final quote. Ask for the exact film, finish, coverage and written warranty terms. No brand or warranty duration is promised here.

title: Ceramic coating
description: Ceramic and graphene coatings for your car.
heading: Which surface needs care?
intro: The catalogue separates paint coatings from surface-specific protection. These are different choices, not one blanket treatment.
choices: Paint
Explore ceramic or graphene coating for painted surfaces. Paint condition is checked before the final quote.
Glass & wheels
Ask about glass or wheel coating separately. Do not assume these are included in a paint coating.
Cabin materials
Leather and fabric coatings are separate catalogue options. Dashboard and trim treatment is enquiry-only. Confirm the surface and product with the studio.
question: Confirm the exact product, preparation, surfaces and aftercare with the studio. Brand sourcing and warranty terms are not fixed by this preview.

title: Detailing
description: Care for the paint, cabin and the details between.
heading: Choose the area to focus on.
intro: Start with the part of the car that needs attention. Cleaning, paint work and protective coatings are separate catalogue choices.
choices: Interior deep clean
For a cabin-focused visit. Confirm the materials and areas to be cleaned.
Full detail wash
The combined option covers exterior and interior. Do not book the same exterior and interior work again.
Paint & finishing / Enquiry
Polish, paint correction and decontamination are enquiry-only types. Call for an assessment and quote; they do not have a direct booking option here.
question: Tell the studio which areas concern you and ask for the work list before approving. A coating or film is a separate decision, not an automatic part of detailing.

title: Washing
description: From a foam wash to a full detail wash.
heading: Outside, inside, or both?
intro: Choose the right scope before opening the app. Full detail wash already combines exterior and interior care.
choices: Foam wash
An exterior-wash starting point in the catalogue. Review its work list in the app.
Exterior detail wash
Choose an exterior-focused visit when the outside is your priority.
Interior deep clean
Choose cabin-focused care when the interior is your priority.
Full detail wash
Choose this for exterior and interior together. Do not add the same exterior and interior services on top.
question: Need both exterior and interior? Start with Full detail wash. For paint correction or surface protection, explore Detailing or Ceramic coating rather than assuming a wash includes it.

title: Paint protection spray
description: A spray-applied paint protection coating. Enquiry only, not yet in the booking catalogue.
heading: Spray-on protection, discussed first.
intro: Paint protection spray is a spray-applied coating intended to protect painted surfaces. Whether it suits your car, and which exact product would be used, is not confirmed yet, so this service starts with an enquiry rather than a booking.
choices: Full car enquiry
Ask whether spray-on protection suits your car and its finish. The studio confirms the exact product before any quote.
Front-end enquiry
Ask about protecting the more exposed front end against road grime and debris. Coverage and product are confirmed with the studio.
Colour change enquiry
Some spray-applied coatings can also change the car's colour while leaving the original paint underneath unaffected, depending on the product. Discuss options with the studio.
question: Ask for the exact product, whether it can be removed cleanly, which surfaces are covered and the aftercare before agreeing to anything. No brand, price or warranty duration is promised here, and availability is not confirmed.
